per_visit_operation: maximum of one complete typed row over all seven frozen types
qualification_conditions: Bind the exact frozen source146 and host11 identities, compiler, target and complete row roster before using this component.
Use the measured root extents and 136-byte SwiftSlot element extent from layout-substitution.json. Arbitrary positive extents are not qualified layouts.
Every resource frontier requires independently justified positive interface work and positive native/resource/backing allowance. Numeric positivity alone proves no bound.
A shared named resource cut must conservatively cover every actual occurrence of that type, including different capacities or callback states; no uniform cap is selected here.
File cuts must cover the actual destructor/resource interface contract and cannot prove close/flush success, descriptor retirement, cleanup or refund.
Error cuts must cover actual backing and all transitive dynamic Error callbacks. A finite bound is not inferred merely from opaque io::Error layout or absent MIR bodies.

Arc cuts must cover the actual clone/refcount/final-owner/deallocation contract and qualified backing. Neither an 8-byte handle nor the separate 24-byte standalone allocation probe proves destructor cost or allocator footprint.
Every Vec/Box cut must cover its actual backing/capacity and complete resource teardown request contract. Inline size does not establish capacity or allocation footprint.

Vec<SwiftSlot> additionally needs a positive conservative live-element bound and the complete 2603 + nested Vec<Type>/Vec<DecodedInstruction>/Vec<u32> element component. All three nested cuts require independent bounds across every live resident.

Source aggregate allowances count declared logical aggregate/field/scalar/control occurrences. They are not reconstructed compiler drop glue, CPU instructions, stack high-water, RSS or physical copies.
Private standard-library/compiler-lowering/allocator/kernel/retry implementation work is outside the inherited logical unit. A future metric that includes it needs additional explicit proof.
Complete whole-host storage/work funding must precede fixture entry and remain retained through payload destruction and eventual retirement. This packet grants no execution authority.
